assertions.title: Sidebar shows Correlation nav with group count badge

steps.observed: Dashboard loaded successfully with expanded sidebar

steps.action: Check sidebar for Correlation nav item
steps.expected: Correlation nav item present with open group count badge
steps.observed: Sidebar shows 'Correlation 1' link with badge showing '1' (open group count)
Sidebar collapsed, Correlation icon visible with '1' badge

steps.action: Hover over Correlation icon in collapsed sidebar
Press Ctrl+K to open command palette
steps.expected: Command palette opens with page list
steps.observed: Command palette opened showing Pages list with all nav items
Option 'Correlation g r' visible in command palette
Only 'Correlation g r' option shown after filtering

steps.action: Press Escape, then press 'g' followed by 'r'
steps.observed: Navigated to http://localhost/correlation via keyboard shortcut

steps.expected: Page loads without redirect to login
steps.observed: Correlation page loaded successfully with Signals, Groups, Config tabs

steps.action: Verify page is under (dashboard) route group
steps.expected: Page renders within dashboard layout with sidebar
steps.observed: Page rendered within dashboard layout with sidebar, top bar, and all dashboard chrome

steps.expected: Config tab accessible (auth_mode=none means effectively admin)
steps.observed: Config tab loaded with editable correlation settings (Window, Min Sources, Confidence Threshold), signal source CRUD (Edit/Remove/Add Source), and per-playbook overrides section

steps.action: Path 1: Navigate to home, expand sidebar, click Correlation
steps.observed: Clicked 'Correlation 1' in expanded sidebar, URL changed to http://localhost/correlation

steps.action: Path 2: Navigate to home, Ctrl+K, type 'corr', press Enter
steps.observed: Command palette filtered to 'Correlation g r', pressed Enter, URL changed to http://localhost/correlation

steps.action: Path 3: Navigate to home, press 'g' then 'r'
steps.observed: Pressed g then r on home page, URL changed to http://localhost/correlation

evidence.network: All 3 paths resulted in successful client-side navigation to /correlation

summary: Tested 4 assertions: 4 passed, 0 failed. Sidebar shows Correlation with group count badge (expanded and collapsed with tooltip). Command palette lists Correlation with 'g r' shortcut and search filtering works. Page is auth-guarded under (dashboard) route group and loads correctly with auth_mode=none. All 3 navigation paths (sidebar, command palette, keyboard shortcut) reach /correlation successfully. No console errors detected.
